# AI NETRA — Technology stack

| Component | Technology | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Development environment | Windows + VS Code | Local source and terminal work |
| Data processing | Python 3.11 / standard-library JSON and CSV | Versioned data transformations |
| Geometry processing | Shapely 2.x, STRtree | Polygon containment, spatial indexing, distances |
| Backend | FastAPI + Uvicorn | Two local REST APIs |
| Frontend | Next.js 16, React, TypeScript | Browser interface |
| Map | Leaflet / React Leaflet | Interactive map and geospatial markers |
| Satellite raster extraction | Google Earth Engine | 2023 Google building height sampling |
| Data formats | GeoJSON, ArcGIS JSON, CSV | Source records and derived attributes |
| Map tiles | OpenStreetMap | Basemap |

Python processing is intentionally designed without Pandas, GeoPandas, or PyProj because of local environment constraints.
